title: From Empty Venue to Big Moment
subtitle: Spaces become experiences, one detail at a time.

storyboard.scene: An original architectural room and floor grid draw themselves into view.
A stage lifts from the plan; a backdrop, screen and layered risers assemble in perspective.
Banquet tables, chairs, flowers, light trusses and entrance details take their places.
Guests arrive, the beams sweep and the venue becomes a luminous event.
Shared Global Connect Travels logo and enquiry end card.
